text:
mike.sales: Hi all — flight to Berlin cancelled, stuck overnight in airport. Bought a lounge daypass (includes buffet breakfast) for €45 and a transit hotel later. Can I expense the lounge and still take per-diem for that day?

nina.peopleops: Sorry you got stuck, Mike. Short answer: lounge daypasses bought for a business disruption are reimbursable. For per-diem, we deduct any meals provided by the lounge from the meal allowance.

lee.finance: Finance notes: upload the lounge receipt + card charge. Category = Travel > Meals/Incidental if it's food-only, or Travel > Transit/Accommodation if the lounge was billed as part of an overnight service. For per-diem adjustment, show line-item: total per-diem less value of lounge buffet.

mike.sales: The lounge receipt doesn't break out food value (just a single line "day pass €45"). How should I estimate the meal portion?

nina.peopleops: If vendor doesn't itemize, use a reasonable allocation: e.g., assume 40% of the pass is food if it advertises buffet/meal access. Put the breakdown in the notes and get manager sign-off. Example: €18 food, €27 facility fee.

lee.finance: We'll accept a pragmatic allocation in the absence of itemization. Add a short note: "allocation used due to non-itemized receipt; manager approved" and include approver mention. For amounts < €75 we usually don't require more proof; > €75 we might request vendor confirmation.

travelbot: Reminder: tag cost_center and project_code or expense will be returned. Use the Travel template and pick approver.

mike.sales: Also paid for a quick nap room/hotel for 4 hours later the same night (company card). Should that be under lodging or miscellaneous?

nina.peopleops: Short-stay rooms (airport transit hotels) are reimbursable under Lodging. Put actual check-in/out times and note "transit/flight disruption". If the stay was < 6 hours and used solely to rest between flights, still acceptable.

lee.finance: Accounting tip: label the hotel as Lodging > Transit to avoid being classified as full-night accommodation for GST/VAT. Attach the hotel's folio or card transaction.

mike.sales: Lost one of the receipts (hotel folio). I have the emailed booking confirmation + card statement. Acceptable?

nina.peopleops: Yes — acceptable. Mark "missing folio" in the notes, attach the booking email and card statement line, and tag your manager for sign-off. If the supplier can reissue folio, ask them first.

lee.finance: If any VAT is recoverable, vendor folio helps. For missing folios we can still process the reimbursement but VAT reclaim may not be possible.

mike.sales: Quick Q on per-diem math: day had dinner at lounge (covered) and then later bought a sandwich from the airport shop. Do I claim partial per-diem?

nina.peopleops: Yes — reduce meal per-diem by the estimated value of the lounge dinner. Small incidental purchases (sandwich) can be included in remaining per-diem, unless you want to itemize. Either is fine.

lee.finance: Sample expense note you can paste:
```
Flight cancelled 2025-10-06 (LH123). Reimbursing transit expenses:
- Lounge daypass: €45 (estimated food €18, facility €27) — refund food value from per-diem
- Transit hotel: €60 (4h rest) — Lodging > Transit
Per-diem eligible amount: daily per-diem €50 - lounge food €18 = €32. Manager @sarah.sales approved 2025-10-07.
```

mike.sales: pasted and submitted. Thanks — saved my sanity. :coffee: :+1:
